name: JsonHelper
src_typeComment: Newtonsoft Json.NET wrapper — use this instead of SaveSystem/JsonUtility when your data has Dictionaries, interfaces, or polymorphic types that Unity's built-in JsonUtility can't serialize. REQUIRES the "Newtonsoft Json" package: Window > Package Manager > Add package by name > com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json. Kept as its own isolated tool so unrelated tools (like SaveSystem) don't force that package on a project that doesn't need it.
